spec_invalidation_restatement.preview: Timeout, crash, or OOM => failed_infrastructure; never a mathematical negative.
Using a field prime as r => invalid_measurement.
Dropping a frozen curve after seeing its factors => invalid_measurement.
Mixing modelled E(r) and measured factorizations in one unlabeled column => invalid_measurement.
Omitting r+1 => incomplete row, not a negative.
Ordinary-ECDLP improvement language in the run report => invalid_measurement (goal pause condition).
Overwriting this specification or a prior run receipt => evidence-integrity failure.
